gaps.explanation: Business-type detail holds only the three utility expenditure lines from the p8 budget-to-actual schedule (budgetary basis); no utility revenue is in detail. The p6 proprietary funds statement prints Water / Sewer / Electric columns (the source used for FY2023/FY2024 detail). Added one line per printed non-zero row: Water Sales 158,597 + Fees 75 + Investment earnings 3,038 = 161,710; Sewer 89,386 + 11,888 + 5,238 = 106,512; Electric 793,626 + 8,849 + Other revenues 1,436 + 11,364 = 815,275. 0 + 1,083,497 = statement 1,083,497 (Total operating revenues 1,063,857 + non-operating 19,640, p6).

gaps.explanation: Detail holds the p8 budget-to-actual utility disbursements on the budgetary (cash) basis: Water 172,493 + Sewer 87,760 + Electric 758,161 = 1,018,414 (indexes 59-61). The statement lines come from the p6 proprietary statement (accrual, incl. Depreciation 48,295): Total operating expenses 1,067,815. Replaced the budget lines with the p6 per-fund cost-type lines (Water 198,651; Sewer 95,244; Electric 773,920), matching FY2023/FY2024 detail. 1,018,414 - 1,018,414 + 1,067,815 = 1,067,815 = statement 1,067,815. (Utility operating transfers in Sewer 1,131 / Electric 1,131 on p6 are also not in detail; no gap row for them.)
